```{r}
library(sf)
library(sp)
library(spdep)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(spatialreg)		
search()

setwd('/Users/przemekturski/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Osobisty/Pliki studia/5. Ekonometria/ekonometria-przestrzenna/data')

# reading regional data
data<-read.csv("regional_dataset.csv", header=TRUE, sep=";", dec=",", encoding="UTF-8")
data23<-data[data$year==2023,]

# reading point data
points<-read.csv("firms_data_utf8.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",", dec=".", encoding="UTF-8")
points.sf<-st_as_sf(points, coords=c("crds.x", "crds.y"), crs=4326)

# Read NUTS4 and NUTS2 contour map (shapefile) into sf class
pov<-st_read("powiaty.shp", options = "ENCODING=UTF-8") # 380 units
pov<-st_transform(pov, 4326) 		# reproject to WGS84
pov<-st_make_valid(pov)			# correct the shapefile object
voi<-st_read("wojewodztwa.shp", options="ENCODING=UTF-8") # 16 units 
voi<-st_transform(voi, 4326) 		# reproject to WGS84

# fragments of maps
region.voi<-voi[voi$JPT_NAZWA_=="lubelskie",] # creating a map subset
units<-which(data23$region_name=="lubelskie")
region.pov<-pov[units, ] 

# macierz wag przestrzennych W wg kryterium wspólnej granicy
# spatial weights matrix W – contiguity
cont.nb<-poly2nb(pov)						# class nb
cont.listw<-nb2listw(cont.nb, style="W")		# class listw

# macierz wag przestrzennych W – odwrotna odległość
# spatial weights matrix W – inverse distance
crds<-st_centroid(st_geometry(pov)) 	# centroidy w sf / sf centroids
pow.knn<-knearneigh(crds, k=379)	# knn for all regions (total 380) 
pow.nb<-knn2nb(pow.knn)			# w klasie nb / here in nb class
# macierz odwrotnej odległości / inverse distance matrix
inv.dist<-nb2listwdist(pow.nb, crds, type="idw", style="raw", alpha=1, dmax=NULL, longlat=TRUE, zero.policy=NULL) # class "listw" "nb"   

```

# x1	unemployment rate					(unemployment_rate)
# x2	distance to core city of region		(dist)
# x3	births per 1K inhab					(birth_per_1K)
# x4 deaths per 1K inhab					(death_per_1K)

# x7 new firms per capita				(new_firms_per_10K_inhab)


# inne zmienne do wykorzystania / other variable to use

# x9 stopa urbanizacji				(urbanisation_pp)
# x10 odsetek ludności w wieku prod	(persons_productive_age_K/ persons_in_K)
# x11 stopa inwestycji publicznych		(invest_share_pp)
# x12 zamknięte firmy per capita		(closed_firms_per_10K_inhab)
# x13 małe firmy per capita 			(small_firms_per_10k_inhab)
# x14 duże firmy per capita		(total_firms_empl.49_per_10K_inhab)
# x15 nowe medyczne firmy pc			(new_medical_firms_pp)
# x16 nowe kreatywne firmy pc			(new_creative_firms_pp)


```{r}
# przygotowanie danych / # data preparation
sub<-data[data$year==2022, ]		# wybór roku / selection of year
sub$y<-sub$salary_avg_Poland_100p
sub$x1<-sub$unemployment_rate
sub$x2<-sub$dist
sub$x3<-sub$birth_per_1K
sub$x4<-sub$death_per_1K
sub$x5<-sub$invest_pc_PLN
sub$x6<-sub$fixed_assets_pc_PLN
sub$x7<-sub$new_firms_per_10K_inhab


# dodatkowe zmienne / alternative variables to try
sub$x8<-sub$persons_per_1km2
sub$x9<-sub$urbanisation_pp
sub$x10<-sub$persons_productive_age_K/sub$persons_in_K
sub$x11<-sub$invest_share_pp
sub$x12<-sub$closed_firms_per_10K_inhab 
sub$x13<-sub$small_firms_per_10k_inhab
sub$x14<-sub$total_firms_empl.49_per_10K_inhab
sub$x15<-sub$new_medical_firms_pp
sub$x16<-sub$new_creative_firms_pp

# równanie modelu / model equation 
eq<-y~x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6+x7

# szybka mapa zmiennej y / quick map of y
library(colorspace)
pal<-rev(sequential_hcl(7, palette="Teal"))
swatchplot(pal)
pov$y<-sub$y

ggplot() + geom_sf(data=pov, aes(fill=y), color=NA) + scale_fill_gradientn(colors=pal) + ggtitle("Dependent variable y") + geom_sf(data=voi, color="black", fill=NA)

```

```{r}
# podstawowy model liniowy / basic linear model

eq<-y~x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6+x7
model.lm<-lm(eq, data=sub)
summary(model.lm)

```
